categories.name: Rock & Gravel
categories.blurb: Crushed limestone, washed gravel, river rock and base material for driveways, roads, drainage and pad sites.

categories.name: Sand
categories.blurb: Concrete, masonry, fill and bedding sand for construction and landscape projects.

categories.name: Soil & Fill

categories.name: Mulch & Compost

items.name: Premium Crushed Limestone
items.summary: Hard-packing crushed limestone for driveways, roads and pad sites.
items.description: Premium crushed limestone compacts tightly and drains well, making it a go-to base for driveways, ranch roads and construction pad sites. Sold in bulk at contractor pricing across the Dallas–Fort Worth area and beyond.

items.name: Flex Base
items.summary: Road base blend that locks together under compaction.
items.description: Flex base is a graded crushed-stone blend with fines that binds under compaction. It is the standard sub-base for roads, lots and slabs in Texas.

items.name: 57 Rock
items.summary: Clean 1-inch crushed limestone for drainage, concrete and driveways.
items.description: 57 rock is a washed or crushed stone sized roughly from 1 inch down to 3/8 inch. It drains freely and is widely used in drainage, concrete mixes and driveway topping. Available at our Fort Worth limestone pit.

items.name: 67 Rock
items.summary: Clean 3/4-inch crushed limestone for drainage, backfill and paths.
items.description: 67 rock is a clean crushed stone sized roughly from 3/4 inch down to 3/8 inch. A popular choice for drainage, backfill and paths. Available at our Fort Worth limestone pit.

items.name: Base
items.summary: Crushed limestone base for slabs, pavers and driveways.
items.description: Crushed limestone base compacts into a stable, level foundation for slabs, pavers and driveways. Available at our Fort Worth limestone pit.

items.name: 2" Oversize Rock
items.summary: Large crushed rock for rough roads, erosion control and construction entrances.
items.description: Oversize 2" rock is used where stability and drainage matter more than a fine finish, such as construction entrances, wash-outs and temporary haul roads.

items.name: Pea Gravel
items.summary: Smooth, rounded stone for walkways, playgrounds and drainage.
items.description: Smooth pea gravel is comfortable underfoot and flows easily, which makes it popular for paths, play areas and drainage backfill.

items.name: River Rock
items.summary: Rounded decorative stone for beds, borders and dry creek beds.
items.description: River rock adds color and texture to landscapes and holds up to weather. Ask us about available sizes and colors.

items.name: Washed Gravel
items.summary: Clean, dust-free gravel for drainage and concrete mixes.
items.description: Washed gravel has the fines rinsed out, so it drains freely and stays clean. Common for French drains and as a concrete aggregate.

items.name: Concrete Sand
items.summary: Coarse sand for concrete mixes and paver bases.
items.description: Coarse concrete sand is used in concrete and as a leveling layer under pavers and flagstone.

items.name: Masonry Sand
items.summary: Fine sand for mortar, joints and play areas.
items.description: Fine masonry sand is screened for mortar and brick work and is also used for sandboxes, arenas and joint fill.

items.name: Fill Sand
items.summary: Economical sand for backfill and leveling.
items.description: General-purpose fill sand for backfilling trenches, raising low spots and general site work.

items.name: Topsoil
items.summary: Screened topsoil for lawns, gardens and grading.
items.description: Screened topsoil gives new lawns and planting beds a fertile base. Delivered in bulk by the load.

items.name: Fill Dirt
items.summary: Structural and general fill for leveling and building up sites.
items.description: Fill dirt for raising grade, filling low areas and building up pads. Call to confirm what is available at the pit nearest you.

items.name: Pit Run
items.summary: Unscreened mix of gravel, sand and fines straight from the pit.
items.description: Pit run is an economical mix of rock, sand and fines used as rough fill and temporary road surfacing.

items.name: Bulk Mulch
items.summary: Shredded hardwood and colored mulch by the cubic yard.
items.description: Bulk mulch saves money on large beds and commercial landscape installs. Ask what colors and blends are in stock.

items.name: Compost
items.summary: Rich organic compost to improve soil structure.
items.description: Organic compost adds nutrients and improves drainage in clay-heavy North Texas soils.
